dossier.scp_unleashed.127.title: The Living Gun
dossier.scp_unleashed.127.caption: SCP-127 at intake. Its magazine could not be removed for the photograph.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-127 is stored upright in a weapon rack inside a Tall Storage Container in the site armoury. It does not fit standard containers and grows agitated when laid flat. **SCP-127 is not to be carried loaded into any populated area.** %rIt is never unloaded.%r
Every kill made with SCP-127 is to be logged. Do not discuss its tally within its hearing.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-127 is a compact 9 mm submachine gun of a common European pattern, with a vertical foregrip, a curved box magazine and a side-folding stock. No serial number or maker's mark has been found.
The magazine cannot be removed. It refills itself over time whether or not the weapon is held, and SCP-127 will not accept ammunition of any kind.
SCP-127 is alive. It is warm to the touch, and warmer after a kill. It also talks, constantly, in a thick Brooklyn accent, but only to whoever holds it.
SCP-127 becomes more dangerous with use. After enough kills its rounds strike harder and its magazine refills faster. Two such changes have been recorded.

page.title: Addendum 127-1: Test Log
text: Test 127-03: fired at a target until empty. The magazine was full again by morning.
Test 127-11: fired at livestock. SCP-127 grew warmer after each kill. %rThe operator reports it also said thank you.%r
Test 127-14: left untouched on a bench for nine days. It whined from the second day on.

page.title: Addendum 127-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-127 has no recovery record. It was handed to a reader of this file by an unidentified individual in Foundation dress, the same one described in other files. %rIt was talking the whole time.%r See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp127_living_gun: SCP-127 is a compact, fully automatic submachine gun that is alive. It never takes ammunition and cannot be reloaded: its magazine slowly regrows rounds on its own, whether it is in your hand or in your pack.
It remembers every kill made with it, and enough of them change it: it hits harder and regrows faster. Its tooltip and the chevrons beside its rounds show how far along it is.
It talks, constantly, in a thick Brooklyn accent, and only the one holding it can hear it. Leave it unused for too long and it grows restless.

It only fits a Tall Storage Container, where it stands upright in its own rack. It cannot be crafted: recover the SCP-127 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal, and a stranger in Foundation dress brings it to you.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp127.0: The courier is the same figure noted in other files.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp127.1: Rack it upright in a tall locker. It sleeps there.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.speaker: SCP-127:
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.equip.0: Ay, there ya are! Whaddaya waitin' for, let's go!
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.equip.3: Ay, easy on the grip, pal. I bruise.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.equip.4: Back in the saddle! Who're we shootin'?
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.equip.5: Look who came crawlin' back. Heh. I'm kiddin', I missed ya.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.equip.6: Finally! I was goin' stir crazy in there.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.equip.7: Alright, alright, I'm awake. Point me somewhere.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.equip.8: Whaddaya got for me today, kid?
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.equip.9: C'mon, c'mon, I ain't got all day.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.equip.10: Ay! Watch them fingers. ...Okay, the trigger's fine.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.equip.11: Me and youse, kid. Just like old times.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.put_away.0: Yeah yeah, go play with ya little stick.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.put_away.4: Ay, I'll be right here. Sulkin'.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.put_away.5: Oh sure, put me away. Real classy.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.kill.0: Now THAT'S what I'm talkin' about!
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.kill.3: Ya see that? Ya SEE that?
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.kill.6: Heh. That one had it comin'.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.kill.9: That's one for the tally, kid.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.level_two.0: Level two, baby! I'm gettin' warmed up!
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.level_two.1: Ohhh, I feel that. I'm gettin' bigger in here, kid.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.level_two.2: Level two! Ya treat me right, I treat ya right.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.level_three.0: Level THREE! Nobody's stoppin' us now!
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.level_three.1: Ay, ay, AY! This is the big leagues, kid!
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.level_three.2: Top of the world, pal! Fuggedaboutit!
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.empty.0: Gimme a sec, I ain't a machine! ...Okay, I'm a machine.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.empty.1: Whoa whoa whoa, I'm runnin' on fumes here!
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.empty.2: Ya squeezin' a lemon, pal. Gimme a minute.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.empty.3: Hold ya horses, they're growin' back!
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.empty.4: What, ya think I'm made of bullets? ...Don't answer that.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.empty.5: Click, click, click. Real nice. I'm empty, kid.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.empty.7: I'm workin' on it, I'm workin' on it!
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.idle.0: Ya gonna shoot somethin' or what?
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.idle.2: Ay. Ya hear that? Me neither. Borin'.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.idle.3: So we're just... standin' here? Great. Love it.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.idle.4: Ya know what I could go for? Anythin'. Literally anythin'.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.idle.5: I'm not sayin' I'm bored. I'm sayin' I'm BORED.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.idle.6: Ya ever think about how I'm a gun? 'Cause I do.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.idle.7: Psst. Somethin' over there looks real shootable.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.hungry.1: Ya forgot about me, didn't ya? Unbelievable.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.hungry.2: When'd we last go out, huh? I'll tell ya when. Never.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.hungry.3: C'mon, just one. One little one. Please?
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.hungry.4: My stomach's growlin'. I don't even HAVE a stomach!
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.hungry.5: Ay. Hello? Remember me? The gun?
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.hungry.6: I'm wastin' away in here, pal.
voice.scp_unleashed.scp127.hungry.7: Whaddaya savin' me for, a special occasion?
